FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Eternal Bliss Wedding Chapels, we specialize in providing romantic wedding ceremonies in an elegant and serene environment. Our core operations focus on coordinating and hosting intimate weddings, ensuring that every couple's special day is memorable and unique. We offer exclusive access to our beautifully designed chapel, which can accommodate up to 100 guests, allowing for a personal and heartfelt experience.

Our services include a dedicated wedding planner who works closely with each couple to customize their ceremony, from script to music arrangements. We also provide essential wedding services such as floral arrangements, decoration, and sound systems, all managed by licensed subcontractors who carry their own insurance, minimizing our liability exposure.

We do not host large receptions, which helps us maintain a focused and secure environment for our clients. Our commitment to risk management and safety compliance ensures that our facilities meet all fire codes and safety regulations, providing peace of mind for our clients.

Eternal Bliss Wedding Chapels aims to create everlasting memories in a safe and beautiful setting, where love can blossom and flourish.
